faqs.question: What are your office working hours?
faqs.answer: Our office hours are Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Indian Standard Time. We are closed on weekends.

faqs.question: Where is OneBridge Infotech located?
faqs.answer: OneBridge Infotech is headquartered in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. We serve clients and students globally.

faqs.question: How can I contact support or sales?
faqs.answer: You can reach our team at support@onebridge.co or visit our website at onebridge.co.

faqs.question: How much do your services or courses cost?
faqs.answer: Our pricing is customized based on your specific requirements and batch schedules. We provide personalized proposals after understanding your scope. May I take your name and contact number so our team can share the detailed fee structure?

faqs.question: Can I book a consultation with leadership or Mr. Vinay Avala?
faqs.answer: Yes, virtual consultation slots via Google Meet or phone can be scheduled with leadership. I can collect your name, phone number, and discussion topic to arrange this for you.

faqs.question: Do you offer certificates and job placement assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, all students receive a recognized OneBridge Academy certification upon capstone completion, along with resume review through our AI Resume Analyzer and mock interview preparation.
